name: portafolio-felipe-rodriguez

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run prerender
scripts.prerender: vite build --ssr scripts/prerender.tsx --outDir dist-prerender --logLevel error && node dist-prerender/prerender.js
scripts.smoke: vite build --ssr scripts/smoke.tsx --outDir dist-smoke --logLevel error && node dist-smoke/smoke.js

description: Portafolio profesional. React 19 + TypeScript + MUI, desplegado en Azure Static Web Apps.
